ctx.x: And Harry told me that first time he heard

me he couldn't believe what he was hearing. That he didn't -- had never thought about playing jazz on it. Never entered it -- in his mind. Such a great player, a xylophone player, as Harry was. And he was on the Cliquet Club Eskimo, course I used to listen to him --
